title: Casa Vista

images.caption: Sunset from the patio up close

description: Look at this little gem in the hills of Rincon. Our private casita offers unobstructed views of the ocean, and the valley below. Being a short 15 minutes from town makes the guesthouse a very quiet and private getaway. Enjoying the cozy casita won't be hard to do. It is equipped with all the comforts of home making it easy for you to relax and enjoy. Give us a try. You won't be disappointed!!The spaceBased on the people that have stayed in the guest house (casita) it is a great place for a getaway, a place where you'll capture nature's energy, from the sounds of the coquí (small whistle sounding frog) at night, to the roosters' songs in the morning and the sight of the red-tailed hawks nesting in one of the mango trees sitting down the hill from the casita’s deck. The casita sits in a corner of the 2 acre property in a spot that allows for one of the greatest views in Rincón. There are two houses, the casita, which was built in May 2017 and is a detached guest house, and the main residence. The two houses share a driveway, but the casita has its own private attached parking space. The casita is a studio type floor plan (approx. 300 sq. ft.) with an equally big patio area, with Adirondack chairs and a small table with two chairs, under a mango tree. All the essentials are included with hot water, air conditioning, indoor/private bathroom, kitchen with fridge/freezer, microwave, dinnerware, gas burner BBQ , and 1 queen bed. There's also a portable two burner stove.Guest accessAs a guest at Casa Vista you will have access to the entire guest house, the parking space and the private patio. You are free to take pictures or videos of the landscape, plants and the views throughout the property. However, we request that you respect our privacy as well and do not use the main residence for photos or use the areas around the main house. However, if you find it hard to maneuver your car around in the casita's parking, feel free to drive into our yard to do so, always taking every precaution. We also ask that you refrain from exploring the terrain below the casita. As guests you will have access to use the casita as your own. We will provide you with bedding, extra blankets, towels, kitchen accessories, beach chairs and accessories and patio chairs.Other things to noteUtility situation: Power has been restored to all of Puerto Rico since Maria and all subsequent hurricanes and storms but the new power company is in the process of restoring the infrastructure and there might be some interruption of services. Please be prepared for any situation that may arise during your stay. We will do our best to deal with any outages that may come (usually after a big thunderstorm) since a lot of the time it is unexpected and we have no control over the situation. In March 2023 we installed solar panels with a Tesla battery and so far it has worked as planned. It is not foolproof of course, especially on rainy season, so we recommend that when you leave the casita you turn off the air conditioner. Internet (WiFi) is available, but like all other utilities we cannot guarantee the reliability of the system. We will however do our best to notify guests if we are having an issue. Cell phone service may be spotty and/or slow at times but then again you are here to relax! Put away those phones and laptops! LOL.GPS works pretty good in PR. We will also provide detailed directions upon booking from whichever airport you are arriving at or place in the island where you're driving from.There are two dogs in the property. Trampa is our son's dog (he lives in the property). She is a rescue dog and she is very friendly and Coco who, at the time of this writing (4/2024) is 2 years and 8 months old. He is also a rescue "sato" or mutt.

description: La Choza is a Eco-Friendly garden cottage near Sandy Beach and just minutes to all popular surf breaks! Vegan or Seagan Meal Plan available! Inquire about our breakfast and dinner options delivered daily for an extra cost. We now run on solar power! New inverter AC! Enjoy the Fruit trees and green vistas from your private deck and you'll hear the waves drifting up on the ocean breezes all night. Things to note-must be comfortable with lots of stairs!The spaceLa Choza strives to be as sustainable as possible- using rain water-catchment, greywater gardening, vermicomposting toilet and are now powered by the 🌞 sun! We just installed a 9.2Kw solar system. 23 panels charging two Tesla Powerwall batteries! When the grid fails, we don’t. 😎 No single use plastics and we use only natural cleaning products and toiletries. If you are looking for an environmentally low- impact vacation look no more! Lot's of love and attention to detail went into every part of this newly built home from the beautiful handmade reclaimed hardwood furniture harvested after hurricane Maria, and the repurposed front sliding barndoors to the plant filled unique outdoor shower-this place is a dream! New Energy efficient Spllit AC!! Hotspot provides strong Wi-Fi💪Guest accessGuests have private use of the La Choza Cottage plus access to explore our acre and a half property!Other things to noteWe are offering a new vegan or seagan meal plan for an extra cost. Daily delivered breakfast and dinner available plus Sunday brunch! We opened and ran a healthy food cart for 7 yrs and after selling it miss cooking-let us cook for you! La Choza is a nature lovers dream! Guests should be comfortable with lots of bird, frog and other nature sounds. And there are 3 flights of wooden jungle stairs to climb which can be a bit of an adventure in the dark or when wet! Please always be careful and hold railings! The cottage does have hot water but be mindful of consumption as we are using a rain water catchment system;) Remember there is only an enclosed plant filled outdoor shower(there could be bugs that visit you! It’s outdoors!) Speaking of bugs-leave your screen doors shut at all times if you don’t want mosquitoes to enter cottage. You have a Water filtration canister for drinking water-if it runs out just fill it from the top with tap water(you have a glass carafe for filling it)-do not move it or take is apart please! Your stove is gas and has an ignition(the star button) no matches are required just turn gas on and press the star button. Please always be sure gas is turned off when not in use!! Garbage should be removed every other day to the orange barrels in the street(we provide you with extra compostable trash bags in the can) if you leave it for more the 3 days fruit flies and maggots😝will come(in the tropics things decay much faster! Put all your open food in the fridge- Bread, cereal etc. or else it might get moldy plus it will attract bugs! If you feel like composting- We have a compost spinner at the top of the wooden stairs-and you have a compost bucket under the sink for any fruit or veggie scraps only-but remember to dump it every other day like the trash;) Unfortunately Rincón only recycles plastic-please rinse your plastic and put it in recycling can and I will remove it when you go. If the power goes out-once it comes back on you might need to reset the wifi by pressing the power button on top of the router(the fridge and electronics are plugged into brownout protectors as PR has a very bad power grid-when power goes out or is low they will turn orange and take 3 minutes to turn back on when power comes back-please do not unplug them! New Ac please always close windows and doors when in use!If you have any questions we are here to help and want you to have the best stay possible-Thanks!

description: Located on Steps Beach in the Tres Palmas Marine Reserve, home to the beautiful sunsets. The rental comes fully stocked with beach chairs, snorkel equipment, sun umbrellas, BBQ grill, organic herb garden, air conditioning, washer & dryer, games, Smart TV and WIFI. The house has 1,000 gallons of reserve water in cisterns in case of a water outage and Solar Panels with Tesla batteries for backup power. Starlink satellite internet for uninterrupted service.The spaceRelax at this award winning beachfront rental, located on Steps Beach in the Tres Palmas Marine Reserve, only 30 minutes from the Rafael Hernández Airport (BQN) in Aguadilla or 2 hours from the Luiz Munoz airport (SJU) in San Juan. Enjoy beautiful sunsets every evening, while dining outdoors on the back patio. World class snorkeling and scuba diving right in front of the house with turtles, exotic fish and the largest elkhorn coral reef in the Caribbean. Stunning views of Desecheo Island, whale sightings occur throughout the winter months and world class surfing can be had at Tres Palmas on Steps Beach. Take a short walk to other famous surf spots such as Dogmans, Maria's and Domes. Fall asleep in the outdoor hammock, while listening to the waves crash. Enjoy organic herbs from R garden while barbequing with friends and family in the back yard. Head out to the many local restaurants and bars within walking distance. If you are looking for something to do other than surf, try scuba diving, sailing, deep sea fishing, horseback riding, yoga or a massage. There are many more activities within minutes of the house.The house has air conditioning in both bedrooms. The master bedroom has a king-size bed. The 2nd bedroom has two double beds. The house comfortably sleeps four people, but can accommodate up to 6 people for an extra fee. There is one parking spot in the driveway on the right side. In case of emergency, the house has over 1000 gallons of reserve water in the cistern in case of a water outage. The property has solar panels and Tesla batteries in case of a power outage. Starlink satellite wifi for uninterrupted internet connection.Nightly minimums during holiday weeksWe are pet-friendly, but one dog only. The owner lives upstairs and offers you privacy, but is friendly if you want to chat.
